material_findings.title: All own_finish calls move wait out of the child-owning shell and mislabel the result as observed
material_findings.mechanism: own_finish executes wait and prints observed <rc>, but every caller invokes it through command substitution; that subshell is not the shell that launched the child, and preserving $$ for the PPID check does not give it the parent's wait authority. [Primitive](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L21-L23) [Wait](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L52-L53) [Enclosure](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-own-launch.v9.sh#L34) [Fixture](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/sup-under-test.v9.sh#L40-L50) [T0](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L172) [Setup](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L184-L192)
material_findings.static_counterexample: For the ordinary natural-exit child that exits 0, FIN=$(own_finish "$PID") attempts wait from the command-substitution environment: the non-child wait status 127 can be printed as observed 127 rather than the child's 0; the enclosure repeats the same defect for the fixture, while C2 expressly requires observed 0 and the ordinary control cases require SUP_RC=0. [Natural-exit fixture](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/sup-under-test.v9.sh#L16-L16) [Capture](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/sup-under-test.v9.sh#L45-L51) [Enclosure and C2](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-own-launch.v9.sh#L34-L48)
material_findings.consequence: A successful npm exit can be reported as failure 127, and T0 can accept a fabricated observed status because its adoption predicate merely excludes 75/76; the advertised actual-wait prerequisite for retirement is also not satisfied by this call shape. [Setup status use](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L192-L199) [T0 acceptance](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L172-L179)
material_findings.minimal_correction: Perform the guarded wait in the original launching shell and return status through parent-shell variables or another non-subshell result channel; distinguish a wait-mechanism error from a workload's genuine exit 127.
material_findings.closure_discriminator: After correction, C2 must observe actual 0, no-ack/stale must observe actual 75, TERM must preserve actual signal status, and the enclosure must preserve each actual fixture status without weakening expectations.

material_findings.title: The T0 successor deletes both cleanup and signal trap registrations
material_findings.mechanism: V9 defines on_exit but deletes V8's trap on_exit EXIT and TERM/INT/HUP registration without replacement; the sourced frozen lib defines logging/check helpers but installs no compensating traps. [Exact deletion](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v8-to-v9-t0-only.diff#L112-L124) [Unused handler](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L137-L144) [Support library](../../s5-v7/controls-v3/lib.sh#L10-L39)
material_findings.static_counterexample: Send TERM to the T0 driver after its ADOPT release has started the detached Jest child: default signal termination exits the driver, with neither on_exit nor own_reap_all invoked, leaving the already released child outside the caller's timeout group. [Release](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L161-L171) [Deleted traps](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v8-to-v9-t0-only.diff#L116-L123)
material_findings.consequence: This is a supported ordinary cancellation regression, not a narrow scheduling/kernel-failure demand; the fixture's installed TERM trap does not prove the actual consumer, and the claimed final cleanup/publication path is unreachable on normal exit as well. [Fixture trap](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/sup-under-test.v9.sh#L13) [Consumer handler](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L139-L143)
material_findings.minimal_correction: Restore the intended traps before any workload can be spawned and bind consumer-level interruption/finalization evidence to those actual registrations.
material_findings.closure_discriminator: Verify the exact consumer trap wiring, then separately authorized pre-adoption and post-release cancellation must reach its owned cleanup and final primary/cleanup receipt.

material_findings.title: Required identity publication is after workload release; setup's checked append failure exits without reaping
material_findings.mechanism: The child execs as soon as ADOPT matches, but both consumers publish required IDENTITY evidence only after own_adopt; setup then handles failure of its EXIT_RECORD identity append with bare exit 74, whose EXIT trap only counts processes and does not reap them. [Gate/release](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L14-L15) [Adoption publication](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L33-L37) [T0 ordering](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L165-L169) [Setup ordering](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L178-L185) [EXIT trap](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L126-L144)
material_findings.static_counterexample: ADOPT is successfully renamed and the gate begins npm ci; the subsequent identity append at setup line 182 fails with a storage/write error, so setup exits 74 while the install continues in its detached session with fd 9 closed; final_accounting observes rather than terminates the child, and this branch does not call quarantine. [Launch fd closure and failing branch](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L178-L185) [Accounting](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L126-L144)
material_findings.consequence: The lease can be released with active install work even though the new publication error is nonzero; if ATT/IDENTITY fails instead, the later refusal text 'npm ci never released' is also false because ADOPT was already consumable. [Refusal claim](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L180-L185)
material_findings.minimal_correction: Treat ADOPT as the release point: finish required pre-release recoverable identity publication first, and route every later fatal publication exit through owned cleanup/recovery; distinguish never-released from released-then-cancelled truthfully.
material_findings.closure_discriminator: The existing C5 only denies ADOPT.tmp creation before release; add or adapt a deterministic consumer-shaped failure after release/at identity publication and require retained ownership plus truthful released-state evidence. [Current C5 seam](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/sup-under-test.v9.sh#L29-L40)

material_findings.title: Some required record failures still do not control final evidence or recovery state
static_counterexamples: T0's EXIT printf can create/truncate the file then fail partway, for example on ENOSPC; the error branch only logs, and the adoption check accepts the file's existence rather than successful complete publication, allowing the named evidence predicate to pass. [T0 write and check](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/ctl-t0-only.v9.sh#L174-L179)

On setup's explicitly supported unresolved-cleanup route, quarantine write failure merely appends QUARANTINE_WRITE_FAILED and then unconditionally appends QUARANTINE written; if the marker was not created, the later S5 precondition has no marker to refuse, while finish still exits and closes the lease. [Quarantine/finalization](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L136-L143) [Existing precondition](../../s5-v7/controls-v3/lib.sh#L33-L35)
material_findings.consequence: The addendum's all-publication-outcomes-checked claim is not met: an error label or existing pathname is not successful evidence publication or checked recovery handoff. [Request claim](../../s5-v9-t0/V9_OWNED_LAUNCH_REQUEST.md#L12-L17)
material_findings.minimal_correction: Latch required write outcomes separately from primary exit and existence tests; never report a quarantine marker written after failure, and define a checked parent recovery disposition before releasing unresolved ownership.
material_findings.closure_discriminator: Reject a created-but-incomplete EXIT record and an absent quarantine marker after a failed write; preserve primary, cleanup and publication outcomes separately without loosening predicates.

material_findings.title: Setup final accounting bypasses the new retired-identity and zombie-aware census
material_findings.mechanism: The new helper filters zombies and retires OWN_PIDS/OWN_PGIDS, but setup keeps the separate legacy OWNED_PGIDS string and final_accounting still runs unfiltered pgrep -g on it; own_retire never clears that string. [Helper census/retire](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L41-L57) [Legacy final census](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L131-L134) [Legacy assignment and retire call](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L186-L197)
material_findings.static_counterexample: After the install leader is gone, let its remaining group contain only a zombie descendant: the new live-session census accepts empty and retirement proceeds, but final_accounting's pgrep still returns that group member and increments CLEANUP_FAILURES; alternatively a later foreign occupant of a retired numeric group is counted as owned even though no active registry authorizes it. [Live filter](../../s5-v9-t0/own-block-v9.sh#L41-L44) [Accounting and FINAL](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L131-L139)
material_findings.consequence: The specific V8B-04 evidence-truth obligation is not closed in the consumer and can turn successful verified-live cleanup into FINAL 90; this finding is false attribution, not an allegation that this legacy accounting loop sends a signal. [Frozen B-04](../owned-launch-v8-b/REPORT.md#L78-L81) [Setup outcome](../../s5-v9-t0/controls-v9-t0/run-s5-setup-npm-ci.v9.sh#L137-L139)
material_findings.minimal_correction: Use the current ownership registry and the same live-versus-zombie/foreign distinction for final accounting; retain historical IDs as evidence, not as current owned-process facts.
material_findings.closure_discriminator: A consumer-shaped final-accounting check must distinguish a live owned descendant, a zombie-only remainder and an already retired/foreign identity without relabeling all three as owned survivors.
